insights.claim: The MLMD gRPC server has no built-in authentication; it supports optional TLS/mTLS via protobuf configuration but the default RHOAI container entrypoint runs without encryption or authentication.
insights.reasoning: The Dockerfile entrypoint passes only --grpc_port and --metadata_store_server_config_file; no TLS certificates are configured by default. The MetadataStoreServerConfig.SSLConfig proto supports server_key, server_cert, custom_ca, and client_verify fields, but these require explicit configuration. In RHOAI, network-level authentication and encryption must be provided by the platform (service mesh, network policies).
